examples.english: This photo is 30 centimeters wide and 20 centimeters tall.

notes:
{横|よこ} indicates the horizontal dimension or the area beside something.

SENSE 1 - BESIDE/SIDE:
- {横|よこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧: to sit beside
- {横|よこ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to look from the side
- {横|よこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧: to line up side by side
- Xの{横|よこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: beside X

SENSE 2 - HORIZONTAL/WIDTH:
- ⟦{横|よこ}{書|が}き→横書き：13188_yokogaki⟧: horizontal writing
- {横|よこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧: horizontal line
- {横|よこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧: wide (horizontally long)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{縦|たて}→縦：17236_tate⟧ (vertical, length) ↔ {横|よこ} (horizontal, width)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{横断|おうだん}→横断：01906_oudan⟧: crossing (⟦{横断|おうだん}{歩道|ほどう}→横断歩道：06502_oudanhodou⟧ = crosswalk)
- ⟦{横顔|よこがお}→横顔：18795_yokogao⟧: profile (side view of face)
